'''Tunjas''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] living on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], where he managed a small shop in the [[Promenade]] area.
